column3: $PRD/policies/tools/restrict-services-supported-$DATE.txt

column1: # OP-0.3 (HUMAN: the person pastes the page's op-set.sh). A test stand-in with the page's interface; see its header.

column3: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$PRD/policies/tools/op-set.sh")" && printf '%s\n' "#!/usr/bin/env bash" "# TEST STAND-IN for setup/13 OP-0.3's op-set.sh, the file a person pastes from the page. Same argument, attachment" "# check, predecessor file and exit codes (2 refused, 3 read-back, 4 predecessor unreadable); the read-back is the exit" "# status of describe, because the offline fake cannot return the policy it was given." "set -euo pipefail" "f=\"\$1\"; : \"\$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR\"" "name=\"\$(jq -r .name \"\$f\")\"; res=\"\${name%%/policies/*}\"; con=\"\${name##*/policies/}\"" "kind=\"\${res%%/*}\"; id=\"\${res#*/}\"" "case \"\$kind\" in folders) flag=\"--folder=\$id\";; projects) flag=\"--project=\$id\";; *) echo \"refused: \$name\" >&2; exit 2;; esac" "d=\"\$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR/policies/predecessors/\$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)\"; mkdir -p \"\$d\"" "pre=\"\$d/\${kind}-\${id}-\${con}.json\"" "if probe=\"\$(gcloud org-policies describe \"\$con\" \"\$flag\" --format=json 2>\"\$d/probe.err\")\"; then printf '%s' \"\$probe\" > \"\$pre\"" "elif grep -qE 'NOT_FOUND|was not found' \"\$d/probe.err\"; then echo '{\"predecessor\":\"none\"}' > \"\$pre\"" "else echo \"PROBE-ERROR \$name\" >&2; exit 4; fi" "rm -f \"\$d/probe.err\"" "gcloud org-policies set-policy \"\$f\" --update-mask='*'" "gcloud org-policies describe \"\$con\" \"\$flag\" --format=json > \"\$d/\${kind}-\${id}-\${con}.applied.json\" || { echo \"READBACK-DIFF \$name\" >&2; exit 3; }" "echo \"APPLIED \$name\"" > "$PRD/policies/tools/op-set.sh"
chmod 755 "$PRD/policies/tools/op-set.sh"
